SELECT
emp_no, emp_name, emp_email, emp_dept_no, emp_position_no, emp_level, emp_state, emp_presence, emp_birth, emp_contact, emp_post, emp_address1, emp_address2, emp_ctime, emp_utime
FROM emp
WHERE
REPLACE( LOWER(emp_name), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
OR
REPLACE( LOWER(emp_email), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
ORDER BY emp_no

SELECT
p.project_no, p.project_name, p.project_purpose, p.project_visibility, p.project_status, p.project_start, p.project_deadline, p.project_ctime, p.project_utime,
/* 프로젝트 전체 참여 인원 */ ( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM project_member pm_count
WHERE pm_count.project_no = p.project_no
) AS memberCount,
/* 현재 로그인 사용자의 역할 */ CASE
WHEN pm.project_member_role = 'owner' THEN 'owner'
WHEN pm.project_member_no IS NOT NULL THEN 'member'
ELSE NULL
END AS projectRole
FROM project p
LEFT JOIN project_member pm
ON p.project_no = pm.project_no
AND pm.emp_no = #{empNo}
WHERE
p.project_status = 'active'
AND p.project_visibility != 'private'
AND (
REPLACE( LOWER(p.project_name), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
OR
REPLACE( LOWER(p.project_purpose), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
)
ORDER BY p.project_ctime DESC

SELECT
t.task_no, t.project_no, p.project_name AS projectName, t.task_title, t.task_content, t.assigned_member_no, t.task_status, t.task_order, t.task_start, t.task_end, t.task_category, t.task_priority, t.task_writer_no, t.task_ctime, t.task_utime
FROM task t
LEFT JOIN project p
ON t.project_no = p.project_no
WHERE
p.project_visibility != 'private'
AND (
REPLACE( LOWER(t.task_title), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
OR
REPLACE( LOWER(t.task_content), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
)
ORDER BY t.task_ctime DESC

SELECT DISTINCT
a.attach_no, a.attach_name, a.attach_type, a.attach_size, a.attach_uploader, a.attach_source, a.attach_source_no, a.attach_ctime,
e.emp_name AS empName,
p.project_name AS projectName
FROM attach a
LEFT JOIN emp e
ON a.attach_uploader = TO_CHAR(e.emp_no)
LEFT JOIN project_file pf
ON a.attach_no = pf.attach_no
LEFT JOIN project p
ON pf.project_no = p.project_no
WHERE
p.project_visibility != 'private'
AND
REPLACE( LOWER(a.attach_name), ' ', '' ) LIKE '%' || REPLACE( LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '' ) || '%'
ORDER BY a.attach_no DESC

SELECT
pm.project_no AS projectNo, p.project_name AS projectName, pm.project_member_role AS projectMemberRole, pm.project_member_job AS projectMemberJob, pm.project_member_ctime AS projectMemberCtime, p.project_status AS projectStatus
FROM project_member pm
INNER JOIN project p
ON pm.project_no = p.project_no
WHERE
pm.emp_no = #{_parameter}
AND p.project_visibility = 'public'
ORDER BY
pm.project_member_ctime DESC

SELECT
e.emp_no AS empNo, e.emp_name AS empName, e.emp_email AS empEmail, d.dept_name AS deptName, p.position_name AS positionName, e.emp_contact AS empContact
FROM emp e
INNER JOIN dept d
ON e.emp_dept_no = d.dept_no
INNER JOIN position p
ON e.emp_position_no = p.position_no
WHERE
e.emp_no = #{_parameter}
